bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for workforce housing development.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+WORKFORCE HOUSING. +]

[+(a) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. +]

[+(b) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the workforce housing development program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.39. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for workforce housing development.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. WORKFORCE HOUSING.

(a) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund.

(b) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the workforce housing development program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.39. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: (a) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund.

(b) $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the workforce housing development program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.39. This is a onetime appropriation.
